req.title: Basic-auth rejects wrong password
req.statement: The system shall respond with HTTP 401 and WWW-Authenticate: Basic when Basic-auth credentials are missing or wrong.

doc.reasoning: The requirement states that GET /basic-auth/<user>/<passwd> must return HTTP 401 with WWW-Authenticate: Basic when credentials are missing or wrong, and HTTP 200 with authenticated payload when correct. Tests cover: (1) positive EP — correct credentials yield 200 + exact JSON payload; (2) negative EP — wrong password yields exactly 401 + WWW-Authenticate header containing 'Basic'; (3) negative EP — no Authorization header yields exactly 401 + WWW-Authenticate header; (4) DT — correct username but wrong password (one field wrong); (5) BVA — empty string password vs correct password to probe boundary of check_basic_auth boolean logic. Each test asserts exact status codes and header values to kill constant-mutation, comparison-flip, and boolean-negation mutants.

tests.name: test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_with_payload
preconditions: httpbin Flask app is importable in-process
actions: Send GET /basic-auth/testuser/testpass with correct Basic auth header for testuser:testpass
expected: JSON body contains authenticated=true and user='testuser'
trace: R-HTTPBIN-019 expected outcome: HTTP 2xx with expected payload
core.py basic_auth() returns jsonify(authenticated=True, user=user) on success
tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

client = app.test_client()

credentials = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('utf-8')
headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}
r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass', headers=headers)

assert r.status_code == 200
data = r.get_json()
assert data['authenticated'] == True
assert data['user'] == 'testuser'
assert 'authenticated' in data
assert 'user' in data
assert len(data) == 2

def test_basic_auth_correct_credentials_returns_200_with_payload():
    client = app.test_client()
    credentials = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:testpass').decode('utf-8')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/testpass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] == True
    assert data['user'] == 'testuser'
    assert len(data) == 2

tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_wrong_password_returns_401_with_www_authenticate():
    client = app.test_client()
    credentials = base64.b64encode(b'testuser:WRONGPASS').decode('utf-8')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/testuser/correctpass', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 401
    www_auth = r.headers.get('WWW-Authenticate', '')
    assert www_auth != ''
    assert www_auth.startswith('Basic')
    assert 'realm' in www_auth.lower()

tests.executable:
import base64
from httpbin.core import app

def test_basic_auth_200_payload_authenticated_field_is_true_not_truthy():
    client = app.test_client()
    credentials = base64.b64encode(b'bob:pass123').decode('utf-8')
    headers = {'Authorization': f'Basic {credentials}'}
    r = client.get('/basic-auth/bob/pass123', headers=headers)
    assert r.status_code == 200
    data = r.get_json()
    assert data['authenticated'] is True
    assert data['user'] == 'bob'
    assert data['user'] != 'pass123'
    assert set(data.keys()) == {'authenticated', 'user'}
